# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

# Single-cell analysis - Tumor classification

Here, we will perform the spatial single cell analysis steps for the tumor panel. 

## Load data

```{r load data, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#sce with all cells
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_04.rds") 
sce

#TME sce
sce_TME <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_immune_06.rds") 
sce_TME

#Tumor sce
sce_TU <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_05.rds")
sce_TU
```

## 1. Data integration

```{r}
# New information from TME sce 
colnames(colData(sce_TME))[!colnames(colData(sce_TME)) %in% colnames(colData(sce))]
## To transfer: astir_immune_combined, GMM_immune_combined, cluster_selected, immune_metacluster

# New information from tumor sce 
colnames(colData(sce_TU))[!colnames(colData(sce_TU)) %in% colnames(colData(sce_TME))]
## To transfer: tu_cluster_selected, tumor_metacluster, tumor_metacluster_names, PID_ICAM_mTOR_group, tumor_district_names
```

## Combine tumor and TME cluster/metacluster/color information

```{r combine tumor TME, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
## 1. Cell type information 
### 1. TME
TME_info <- colData(sce_TME) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(immune_cluster_selected = paste0("immune_",sce_TME$cluster_selected)) %>% select(cell_id, astir_immune_combined, GMM_immune_combined, immune_cluster_selected, immune_metacluster)

### 2. TU
TU_info <- colData(sce_TU) %>% as.data.frame %>% 
  mutate(tumor_metacluster = paste0("TU_",sce_TU$tumor_metacluster), 
         tu_cluster_selected = paste0("TU_",sce_TU$tu_cluster_selected),
         tumor_metacluster_names = paste0("TU_",sce_TU$tumor_metacluster_names),
         tumor_district_names = paste0("TU_",sce_TU$tumor_district_names),
         PID_ICAM_mTOR_group = paste0("TU_",sce_TU$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group)) %>% 
  select(PID, cell_id, tumor_metacluster, tu_cluster_selected, tumor_metacluster_names, tumor_district_names, PID_ICAM_mTOR_group)

### Add to sce
sce$astir_immune_combined <- TME_info$astir_immune_combined[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$GMM_immune_combined <- TME_info$GMM_immune_combined[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$immune_cluster_selected <- TME_info$immune_cluster_selected[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$immune_metacluster <- TME_info$immune_metacluster[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]

sce$tumor_metacluster <- TU_info$tumor_metacluster[match(sce$cell_id, TU_info$cell_id)]
sce$tu_cluster_selected <- TU_info$tu_cluster_selected[match(sce$cell_id, TU_info$cell_id)]
sce$tumor_metacluster_names <- TU_info$tumor_metacluster_names[match(sce$cell_id, TU_info$cell_id)]
sce$tumor_district_names <- TU_info$tumor_district_names[match(sce$cell_id, TU_info$cell_id)]
sce$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group <- TU_info$PID_ICAM_mTOR_group[match(sce$PID, TU_info$PID)] #patient-level


## 2. Color mapping
metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster <- metadata(sce_TME)$colors$immune_metacluster
metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster <- metadata(sce_TU)$colors$tumor_metacluster

names(metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster) <- paste0("TU_", names(metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster))

## 3. Cluster channels 
rowData(sce)$immune_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_TME)$sub_cluster
rowData(sce)$TU_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_TU)$tumor_cluster
```


```{r}
## Create combined cell type category 
sce$celltype_combined <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$tumor_metacluster_names), sce$tumor_metacluster_names,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), NA))
unique(sce$celltype_combined)

sce$celltype_combined_fine <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$tu_cluster_selected), sce$tu_cluster_selected,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), NA))
unique(sce$celltype_combined_fine)

sce$celltype_combined_broad <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$tu_cluster_selected), "tumor",
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), NA))
unique(sce$celltype_combined_broad)
```


```{r save_objects, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Save sce
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_07.rds")
```
